data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental no license prices 2040 guide? You’ve come to the right place. Renting a boat in Marbella without a license is straightforward, and the all-inclusive pricing means no surprises. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an 8-hour island-hopping day, our fleet of skippered boats from Puerto Banús covers every budget. Below, you’ll find the exact prices, what’s included, and how to book.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2040: The Numbers

We operate two pricing tiers for 2040. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. No hidden fees.

BoatLengthMax PaxPrice 2hPrice 4hPrice 8h
Astondoa 4012.5m9€749€1,299€2,299
Azimut 3912.5m11€749€1,299€2,299
Mangusta 80 (white/grey)24m12–€4,719*–

*Mangusta 80 minimum charter is 4 hours, includes a free jet ski. For other boats (Pershing 46, Fairline Targa, Lagoon 380, etc.), pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

What’s Included in Every Charter

Every booking covers: licensed skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You won’t pay extra for anything listed. Bring your own food if you like.

No License Required – Here’s Why

Spanish law requires a license for bareboat charters over 6m or with engines above 15hp. But we provide a professional skipper on every boat, so you don’t need any paperwork. The skipper handles navigation, mooring, and safety – you just enjoy the coast.

Which Boat Should You Choose?

  • Small groups (5 pax): Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) – great for a quick spin.
  • Couples or families (8-11 pax): Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 – best value from €749/2h.
  • Larger parties (12 pax): Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or Ferretti 94 – luxury with space.
  • Speed lovers: Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or the 7m Speedboat – ask for price.

Where You’ll Cruise

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. Popular routes include: east to Cabopino or Cala del Faro, west to Estepona or Sotogrande. You can anchor for swimming, snorkelling, or lunch. The skipper knows the best spots – just tell them your preference.

How to Book

For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) and Tier B (Mangusta 80), pricing is listed above. For any other boat, contact us on WhatsApp for a custom quote. We respond within minutes. Browse our full fleet here.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a boat license to rent a boat in Marbella?

No. Every boat on our fleet comes with a licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You just relax and enjoy.

What is the cheapest no-license boat rental in Marbella?

Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 – start at €749 for 2 hours. That includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT. No hidden costs.

What’s included in the Marbella boat rental price 2040?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Can I rent a boat for a full day without a license?

Yes. Tier A boats cost €2,299 for 8 hours. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 for 4 hours minimum, with a free jet ski included.

How many people can go on a no-license boat charter?

Capacity ranges from 5 pax (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 pax on most larger boats like the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or Ferretti 94.

Where do the boats depart from?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s famous marina. You can also arrange pick-ups from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, or Estepona on request.

What if I want a specific boat not in Tier A or B?

For boats like the Pershing 46, Fairline Targa, or Lagoon 380, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. We’ll send you a custom quote within minutes.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes. You’re welcome to bring your own food and extra drinks. The included bar covers water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava – plus light snacks.
